summary: The party caucus, not the voters, fills a vacant council seat, and the winner is a party officer.
realLife: In New Albany the Democratic caucus filled a council seat and chose the county party chair.
sources: News and Tribune via Yahoo, Adam Dickey to fill vacant New Albany City Council seat: https://news.yahoo.com/adam-dickey-fill-vacant-albany-022300501.html
